bullets.text: A road cave-in on Velachery Main Road near Phoenix Marketcity halted traffic, and the office should monitor Metrowater repairs urgently.

The Murasu cyclone is moving toward South Andhra Pradesh with an orange alert for Chennai and Thiruvallur, requiring close watch.
The Tamil Nadu Vanigar Sangangalin Peramaippu youth wing held an anti-drug marathon in Besant Nagar, and the constituency team should note community engagement.
India data centre capacity may reach 2 GW in 2026 driven by AI demand, and the portfolio team should watch digital infrastructure expansion.
The Global Startup Summit 2026 will happen on November 14 at Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway, and the office should prepare for founder and investor engagement.

stories.title: Road cave-in near Phoenix Mall brings Velachery traffic to a halt
takeaways: A sudden road cave-in on Velachery Main Road near Phoenix Marketcity completely halted traffic before Diwali.
Metrowater officials rushed to inspect the site and coordinate urgent repairs to restore normal traffic flow.

reports.title: Chennai may get moderate rain from Monday as Cyclone Murasu moves towards AP coast

takeaways: The Murasu cyclone formed in the Bay of Bengal and is heading towards south Andhra Pradesh.
An orange alert has been issued today for Chennai and Thiruvallur districts due to expected severe weather.
